items.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
items.content: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI
items.contentSnippet: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI

summaries.zh: OpenAI的“forward deployed engineering”指的是将工程团队直接部署到项目一线，以快速推进研发和解决实际问题。这种模式有助于缩短开发周期，提升效率，并确保技术方案更贴近实际应用需求。通过这种方式，OpenAI能够更灵活地应对技术挑战，加速创新进程。
summaries.en: Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) at OpenAI involves engineers who work closely with customers to deploy and integrate AI models into real-world applications. FDE focuses on solving practical challenges, ensuring seamless integration, and optimizing model performance in production environments. The role bridges research and application, enabling rapid deployment and feedback loops. Key aspects include hands-on implementation, collaboration with stakeholders, and addressing operational issues. FDE aims to translate AI advancements into tangible solutions for clients. The initiative enhances OpenAI's ability to deliver scalable and effective AI systems.
